title: International Khiladi
desc: Reporter Payal is sent to interview criminal Devraj. During the interview, they fall in love, but this upsets Devraj's guardian and creates trouble for them.

title: Tapasya
desc: Indu, eldest daughter of a sick man, falls for her father's doctor. But her lover's mother demands she abandon her family and place her in-laws above all else.

title: Dream Girl
desc: Karamveer lands a call-center job thanks to his knack for mimicking a woman's voice. Fame follows, but trouble brews as obsessed clients push him into dangerous territory.

title: Ek Aur Ek Gyarah
desc: Tara and Sitara, thieves, hide in Major Ram Singh's house. When Cobra kidnaps their mother, they must deceive Ram to save her and free Panther.

title: Uri - The Surgical Strike
desc: After a deadly terrorist attack in Uri, Major Vihaan Singh Shergill leads a covert operation to eliminate the terrorists responsible, executing a high-risk mission deep across the border.

title: Henna
desc: An Indian man falls into a river, losing his memory and drifting into Pakistan. Villagers care for him, but tragedy strikes when his forgotten past painfully resurfaces.

title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
desc: After losing custody of his daughter to Maya, Abhay dies in an accident. Soon, his restless spirit returns, haunting their peaceful lives and unsettling their newfound happiness.

title: Mr. India
desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

title: Crook
desc: Jai, a small-time crook equipped with a new identity, is sent to Australia by his uncle. However, there he gets embroiled in the ongoing racial conflict while also trying to pursue his love interest.

title: Khichdi 2: Mission Paanthukistan
desc: When an intelligence agent discovers Praful's uncanny resemblance to the king of Paanthukistan, he seeks the Parekh family's help to replace the missing monarch and save the kingdom from crisis.

title: Yes Boss
desc: Rahul tries to satisfy his demanding and womanizing boss. Rahul now has to choose between saving innocent Seema or following his dream of becoming big.

title: Zeher
desc: Siddharth, a police officer facing divorce, begins an affair with Anna. When she's found dead, he realises he's entangled in a dangerous mystery beyond his control.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: Loafer
desc: Ravi, an unemployed man, is framed for a gangster's murder. With no support from his family, he must fight alone to prove his innocence.

title: Singh Is King
desc: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.
